subject: biology
title: Built on Bones
welcome_lead: Explore the four key jobs of your skeleton and the bones that keep you upright.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on the functions of the human skeleton.
final_note: You now know the four key jobs your skeleton does every day.

concepts.def: Framework of bones in the body.
Allowing the body to move at joints.
Tissue inside bones that makes blood cells.
Bones that protect the lungs and heart.

walkthroughs.body_html: The skeleton has four key roles: support, protection, movement, and making blood cells in the bone marrow.
The skull protects the brain. The ribcage protects the lungs and heart. The backbone protects the spinal cord.
Inside large bones is soft tissue called bone marrow. It produces millions of new red and white blood cells every day.
